notes: Expanded the canonical firearm catalog from 16 to 81 base-model guns across Bastion, Corvus, ForgeLine, Helix, Jade Arc, Kurohane, and Vektor.
Gun class dice remain consistent while dice count, physical magazine, functional attacks, range, reload, and STR carry most model identity.
Ballistic magazines track physical capacity separately from attacks-before-reload; shotgun d2 values represent pellets and consume shells rather than one round per die.
Helix uses ENERGY EFFICIENCY, Jade Arc uses OVERDRIVEN ENERGY, and Kurohane uses LOW SIGNATURE as manufacturer-wide doctrines.
Corvus remains the deliberate exception: all seven Corvus guns have bespoke neural/network subsystems.
Weapon descriptions now contain an editable GM REVIEW NOTES block and are seeded only once per review seed so manual Foundry edits survive ordinary loader reloads.
Suffixed/reskin variants remain outside the canonical 81-gun catalog and stay NOT DONE.
